chapter_seo_title: RMJI Ch 528 – Transformative Heavenly Tribulation & Qiyuan Island Danger
chapter_meta_description: A grade-seven demon turtle undergoes its Transformative Heavenly Tribulation near Han Li’s cave, forcing him to confront the risk of a grade-eight predator next door.
og_title: A Mountain-Sized Turtle Ruins Han Li’s Peace
og_description: Han Li’s one-year seclusion ends with a world-shaking surprise: a grade-seven demon turtle attempting its tribulation right next to his newly built cave on Qiyuan Island.
twitter_title: Chapter 528: When Your Neighbor is a Thunder-Surviving Turtle
twitter_description: Han Li’s peaceful island life is shattered by a thousand-zhang turtle enduring heavenly lightning. His cold calculation: fight, or flee?

lore_anchors.definition: A lightning tribulation that grade-seven demon beasts must survive to advance to grade-eight, gaining the ability to partially assume a human form. Higher grades allow more complete transformation, with grade-ten beasts appearing fully human.
The highest pre-humanoid tier for demon beasts in the *Mortal Stream* setting, representing a beast of immense power that has not yet undergone the tribulation to achieve partial human form.

A post-tribulation tier where a demon beast has successfully transformed part of its body into human shape, gaining a massive increase in intelligence and combat capability. Equivalent in threat to a Nascent Soul-stage cultivator.
A legendary alchemy ingredient made from a thousand-year spiritual dewdrop, used in high-grade pill formulas. Its existence is Han Li’s primary reason for venturing to the Qiyuan Island sea region.
Han Li’s prized swarm of spirit insects, currently in an egg-laying cycle after a feeding phase. When hatched, they will be a leveled-up tactical asset.
